bounds_provenance: Fixed engineering search bounds, not independent material measurements
local_refinement: three predetermined 21x21 logalpha/b grids around the previous optimum
primary_goal: weighted residuals of DC ratio and complex daily and twice-daily ratios
diagnostic_goal: same harmonic ratios without DC, no post-result winner selection
ratio_scales: OLS row-L1 propagated source +/-0.2C deterministic bound; not Gaussian sigma or statistical confidence
null: b=0 with same alpha bounds, observation ratios and weights
rank_check: weighted local Jacobian in log(alpha), b/L; finite difference h=1e-4
claim_ceiling: effective homogeneous Robin response conditional on nominal geometry, steady periodic forcing and melting ice; not independent physical contact identification
